// diagnostic

E0988

This uses a retired loop-label or dot-exit form.

What

This uses a retired loop-label or dot-exit form.

Why

Named exits are keyword-led: `break(name)`, `break(name, value)`, and `next(name)`. A loop name is not a runtime object.

Fix

Replace the dot or `@` form with the matching target-argument exit. Keep the declaration as `name :: loop`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0988: tests/ui/label_not_on_loop.stderr.

Error [E0988]: a loop name is compile-time, not mutable state
  --> tests/ui/label_not_on_loop.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     outer := loop
    |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `:=` creates a runtime binding; a loop name only targets control flow
 Fix: write `outer :: loop { … }`
